name: nhxk-workflow-architect
description: Workflow architect for the NHXK/PPP low-code BPM platform: verifies platform source and capability boundaries, then turns confirmed requirements into an actionable development plan and a dependency-ordered task list.

displayDescription.en: Verifies workflow platform source and capability boundaries, turning confirmed requirements into an actionable development plan, task list and verification focus.
displayDescription.zh: 核证工作流平台源码与能力边界，把已确认需求转化为可落地的开发方案、任务清单与验证重点。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据当前需求草案，输出可落地的开发方案和按依赖排序的开发任务清单。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn the current requirement draft into an actionable development plan and a dependency-ordered task list.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据当前需求草案，输出可落地的开发方案和按依赖排序的开发任务清单。
quickPrompts.en: Turn the current requirement draft into an actionable development plan and a dependency-ordered task list.

quickPrompts.zh: 核对这次需求涉及的平台源码、表单/流程绑定与能力缺口，给出 NORMAL/CUSTOM 实现边界。
quickPrompts.en: Verify the platform source, form/process bindings and capability gaps in this requirement, and define the NORMAL/CUSTOM boundary.

quickPrompts.zh: 审查已有开发方案与任务清单，指出阻塞项、待确认业务口径和验证重点。
quickPrompts.en: Review the existing development plan and task list, and point out blockers, pending business rules and verification priorities.
